name: Slack
project_description:
Slack brings all your communication together in one place. It’s real-time messaging, archiving and search for modern teams, and it has cool system integrations features.

 This module allows you to send messages from Drupal website to Slack.

It has Rules module integration.

Also you can use our module API in your modules.

 Slack 2.0.x: 

Complete module rewrite utilizing Slack API. There is no upgrade path from 8.x-1.x for now.

 Slack 8.x-1.0: 

Drupal 8 port is released.

Please, If you found any bugs let us know and open issue.

 Slack 7.x-1.5: 

Icons support for your slackbot (icons and emoji).

Slack friendly tags were added. If " http://www ."-part is not added in href, slack will represent your link as relative path.

 Slack 6.x-1.0: 

Drupal 6 support.

 If you update the Slack module, you need to re-configure module settings.

 Created by ADCI solutions team
